identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18A-UNITY] Complete the Unity Observatory Runtime v3 client

values.review_scope: Unity adapter boundaries, shared-schema compatibility, main-thread state delivery, authorization, reconnect correctness, failure rendering, and live native proof.
review_prompts: Can the Unity compatibility resource diverge from the shared Runtime contract?
Can reconnect callbacks race Unity lifecycle or duplicate an event?
Can any control imply or exercise authority the Runtime denied?
Can cached or fixture state be presented as live?
Can tokens, keys, private state, or sealed data leak into assets or evidence?
